relevance_note: Case report of a family with a LAMP2 frameshift variant: "the frameshift variant c.190\_191delАС in the LAMP2 in the family with sudden cardiac death history and three members with cardiomyopathy", plus a literature table of 13 females with LAMP2 mutations.
method_note: Read the whole paper; a Python script in scratch assembled the JSON, transcribing Table 1 rows (No, age at cardiomyopathy diagnosis, age at HT, Mutation, Reference) and Table 2 row segments; the transcribed cells were checked against the tables by eye and every span was checked verbatim by script. In scope: proband II-2 (female), her sons III-2 and III-3 (carriers), her mother (sudden cardiac death at 30, untested; labelled "mother of II-2"), 12 previously published females from Table 1 (labels "Table 1 #k" from the bare-number No column; source_reference_in_review from the Reference column), and one woman from Arad et al. [22] who died of congestive heart failure at 44 (variant not printed, row kept with "not reported"). Table 1 row 3 ("This report") is proband II-2 and was not given a separate row. The six asymptomatic women from Arad et al. [22] (aged 14-49) are described only at group level and got no rows. Patient counts in the Introduction (Charron, Gurka) are group-level and got no rows. The proband's third child (third pregnancy) and other pedigree members (Fig. 2) are not described individually in the text and got no rows. Table 2 has patients as columns with two ages each; header cells: "Proband, female (II-2) - 34", "Proband, female (II-2) - 36", "Сhild, male (III-2) - 10", "Сhild, male (III-2) - 14", "Child, male (III-3) - 3", "Child, male (III-3) - 7". The symbol "N" in Table 2 is not defined in a legend, so N cells were treated as not reported (e.g., developmental delay for II-2 and III-3; muscle weakness and CK for II-2 were excluded from the text, not from N cells). "↑" was read as elevated CK, also supported by the text. No stacked " / " cells occur. The paper prints the variant mostly with Cyrillic letters "АС" (c.190\_191delАС); the Latin form c.190\_191delAC is printed in two section headings and was used for variant_original_string and cdna_hgvs_as_stated. Transcript NM_001122606.1 is printed next to the variant in the TaqMan assay description (Methods); the Sanger primers refer to NM_007995.1. Zygosity was left not reported for all (the paper does not say heterozygous/hemizygous for these persons' LAMP2 variant). Variant type for Table 1 exon deletions/duplication recorded as large deletion/CNV from the printed "Deletion of exons"/"Duplication of exons"; other Table 1 variant types not stated. "HCD" in Table 1 is not defined in the legend. Asymptomatic Table 1 women got no phenotype rows; their age is recorded as age at last evaluation. D-27: "Coronary angiography was normal" recorded as excluded "abnormal coronary angiography" (an investigation as a whole; nothing more specific excluded). III-2 "good contractility" recorded as excluded "reduced LV contractility"; checklist dilated/hypokinetic LV left not reported because dilation is not addressed. Contradictions/inconsistencies: Table 1 gives age at heart transplantation 37 for the proband (row 3) while Table 2 gives 36; treatment recorded without an age from Table 1. The text twice cites "Table 2" for the literature XCI data that are in Table 1. For III-3 the text says he "didn't show any significant neuromuscular involvement due to his young age" while Table 2 records skeletal myopathy "+ (mild)" at age 7 and the abstract says the two males presented with mild skeletal myopathy; both rows emitted, checklist kept observed from Table 2 since the text excludes only significant involvement at a younger age.
